notes: Added an application icon: the main window, About, Export History, Find, New Command and Scope windows now all show the same icon
The executable and the setup package carry the same icon, so Explorer, the taskbar and Apps & Features identify the app at a glance
Fixed the log not scrolling automatically: both the row list and the plain-text view scroll to the newest entry, and still stay put while you scroll back through history
Added in-app auto-update: the manifest is checked silently at startup and the About window offers Check for Updates and Update Now, so the Release page no longer has to be opened by hand
Downloaded packages are verified against the manifest's SHA256 and size; a mismatch is discarded and the install directory is left untouched
Portable copies unpack over the install directory; copies installed by the setup run it silently, keeping the uninstall entry and the version in Apps & Features accurate
An update only writes the files present in the package, so config.json, Logs, Rules, export history and production data are preserved
Replacement runs in a detached script after the app exits: it waits for the process, swaps the executable atomically and relaunches, logging failures to update.log
The About window shows the check result and download progress, and marks the update as required when the manifest sets forceUpdate
The release manifest now carries installerUrl, installerSha256 and installerSize, kept in sync by CI and the local release script; older manifests without these fields still update as a portable copy
Version history in the About window now uses the same comparison as update checks, accepting a v prefix and prerelease suffixes such as -beta

Fixed the Auto-send checkbox in the command list not being manually uncheckable: its state now stays in sync with the command rule and is saved to the current device type's rule override right after toggling
The side-pane + button now opens a custom-command dialog for name, send frame, format (HEX/ASCII) and auto-send; the command is added to the list and saved to the current rule

Rule page is now responsive: file-rule fields sit on one row with the path column taking the remaining width, the page scrolls vertically and horizontally when content still overflows, and table columns have narrower minimum widths, so nothing gets clipped when the window is small

Fixed the whole rules page being dead: it never received its data source, so the browse button opened nothing, the export-type list was empty and the auto-reply table showed no rows; the workspace now hands its view model down directly and the file rules work as soon as the page opens
File rules gained a path preview row that shows the resulting file path from the current directory, name placeholders and export type while you edit
The first serial device is selected once the port list loads, so the file rules have a device to edit without clicking a row first
Export path and file name edits in the file rules are saved with a 300 ms debounce instead of rewriting the rule file on every keystroke
Main window now has a fixed minimum size of 800x450 so the UI cannot be shrunk into an unusable layout

Fixed the log Find button doing nothing: the find dialog's close button pointed at a wrong icon path, so the dialog threw while loading and the global handler swallowed the error; the path is corrected, and a failed open now logs and shows a message
Find now highlights matches in the log list: the current keyword (and each condition of a filter expression) gets a highlighted background in all four match modes (contains, whole word, exact, regex)

Fixed the log list not restoring hidden rows after clearing the find keyword: the filtered view is refreshed whenever the filter state changes, and closing the find dialog restores the full list as well
Find input is debounced (180 ms) and compiled regexes are cached, so live filtering stays smooth on logs with tens of thousands of rows
Fixed regex mode not working under Filter: backslash was treated as the AND separator, so expressions like \d+ never matched; the whole expression is now interpreted as one regex
Find dialog layout is adaptive: the window is wider (430), the keyword box stretches, the close button is icon-only with a tooltip, and the action buttons are no longer clipped

Fixed real-time write creating a new file for every second: the default file name is now per-day, and the {datetime}/{time} placeholders stay at the moment recording began, so the same device keeps appending to one file all day and only rolls over at midnight

The file rules section now has an Export History button listing the start/end time, file, line count and byte count of each real-time write session; the history is stored locally and keeps the latest 500 entries

The HEX switch now also controls the send format: when checked, send-box content is parsed as hex bytes (41 42, 4142, 0x41,0x42 all accepted); malformed input shows a message, sends nothing and keeps the draft
Fixed chart parsing: fields from different lines of one report group (solar/battery/LED/RSSI) leaked into each other, so LED power duplicated the solar panel values
Fixed an exception thrown when sorting the chart record table by a column header
Serial writes and port-info queries moved off the UI thread, so a timing-out port no longer freezes the window periodically

Connecting no longer closes and reopens the port for baud-rate probing, which left some USB serial devices silent for a long time after a reopen; the probe window is shortened from 600 ms to 350 ms and ends early once enough data arrives
Added an 'assert DTR when opening the port' setting (on by default), fixing devices that never report data unless DTR is raised

Global debug log backend switched to NLog: regular logs go through an async queue that back-pressures instead of dropping events, error logs are written synchronously; log UI, level filter and directory switch stay unchanged

Oscilloscope window: added screenshot capture of the chart and measurement table, copied to the clipboard at 2x with a white background; exposed CaptureSnapshot and a snapshot directory for later export
Oscilloscope chart switched to a light theme; horizontal cursor color adjusted to stay readable on white
Oscilloscope axis labels, measurement table headers, table toolbar and measurement row names unified to English, fixing garbled CJK tick labels
Voltage/div lower limit extended to 1 mV/div, with extra decimals on mV-scale tick labels
Refactored the serial module into layered Connection/Framing/Rules/ViewModels/Views structure
Reference rules refined
Added instrument scope window and device panel view
Added real-time file recording service and storage module
Added checksum, frame parsing, rule engine and edge-case test projects
Added auto versioning, one-click release script, Inno Setup installer and OTA upgrade pipeline
Status bar clock is now synchronized in real time, refreshing every second with full date and time
The clock shares the same source as logs (local system time) and can be used as the test record time baseline
Added serial hot-plug: device list auto-refreshes on plug/unplug with 500ms debounce
Added auto-reconnect: a connected device is reconnected by VID/PID after reinsertion; manual disconnect disables it
Hardened repeated hot-plug stability: rapid plug cycles inside the debounce window rebuild the stale handle, and reconnect waits for in-flight probing to finish to avoid port contention
Added multi-language switching with runtime hot-swap between Chinese and English
Added scrollable version history
Improved UI refresh; switching language keeps connections and data
Added multi-serial, TCP and MQTT protocol framework
Added customizable log directory with reset to default
First official release with multi-serial communication and logging
